AP-SKILL-RELOAD.description: Same Skill invoked >1× in a session — wastes full SKILL.md reload (~6k tokens each).
AP-SKILL-RELOAD.fix: After the first Skill load, call sub-commands via Bash directly. Do NOT re-invoke Skill(make,...) or Skill(chat,...) within the same session.

AP-MAKE-BYPASS.description: Bash runs pytest/ruff/pylint/mypy directly — bypasses make targets.
AP-MAKE-BYPASS.fix: Always use `bobp make <target>`. Output is captured to build/build.out.

AP-RAW-VENV.fix: Use `bobp make <target>` — never reference .venv/bin directly. If no target exists, add one to this project's own Makefile.

AP-MAKE-PIPE.description: Bash pipes `bobp make` output — it already captures to build/build.out.
AP-MAKE-PIPE.fix: Run `bobp make <target>`, then tail -n 30 build/build.out. Or use `bobp make -vv <target>` to see failures live. Never pipe.

AP-VIA-GREP.description: Grep/Glob used for symbol/import/function lookup when via is enabled.
AP-VIA-GREP.fix: Use mcp__via__via_query for symbol lookups. Reserve grep for free-text content search only.

AP-VIA-READ.description: Read on a source file with no subsequent Edit/Write — likely symbol hunting.
AP-VIA-READ.fix: Use mcp__via__via_query to locate symbols. Read is only needed before editing or full-file review.

AP-DUP-READ.description: Same file Read 3+ times in one session without the file changing.
AP-DUP-READ.fix: Read once, keep excerpt in context. Re-Read only to verify after an edit.
